items.name: 08d-before-messy
items.prompt: Edit this photo into a realistic BEFORE version of the very same utility room from the same camera position: keep the walls, window, floor, washing machine, tumble dryer and cabinet positions exactly the same, but make it messy and dated: a piles of unfolded laundry heaped on the worktop and on top of the machines, a few plain unlabelled detergent bottles scattered around, the open shelf cluttered, a laundry basket overflowing on the floor, the cabinet doors painted plain dull white instead of sage. No text, no logos, no labels on anything. Photorealistic.
